description: Queue up to 10,000 phone numbers for asynchronous validation. Returns a job id immediately — poll get_job_status for progress and results. One validation per definitive result; duplicates are collapsed before counting. A job runs at the plan's bulk pace, 4 to 20 rows a minute and slower than validate_number on purpose, so a long list takes hours: tell the person, and check back rather than waiting in a loop.

phones.description: Phone numbers in E.164 format. Duplicates are removed automatically.

name: bulk_validate
